content:
marcos: rolling v2 to prod now — canary 10% -> 50% over next 20m. keeping rollback window 60m. deploy-bot will post events.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: v2-api canary 10% -> 50% over 20m. owner: marcos. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/v2-rollout (pin + rollback steps included).

ada: seeing a spike of 502s from mobile SDK 1.3.2, ~0.8% of requests, EU-west. logs show "incompatible request schema" on /chat/stream endpoint.

priya.k: interesting — are they hitting the new structured_output param? older SDKs might still send output_hint which we no longer accept.

jason: quick check: can we pin mobile clients to v1 via header/UA fallback? we have routing that can match user-agent. quick mitigation would be to pin UA mobile-sdk/1.3.2 to v1.

marcos: @deploy-bot pin route client:mobile -> v1 for 1h, reason: 502 spike from legacy SDKs, owner=marcos. execute now.

deploy-bot: action: route pin applied. route=client:mobile, pinned_version=v1, duration=3600s, who=marcos. matching rule: UA regex mobile-sdk\/1\.3\.2. audit_id=rb-2267899999-1.

samir: nice. i'll open a gateway PR to re-add tolerance for legacy field mappings as a follow-up (small mapping patch, low risk). PR in ~10m.

ada: after pin errors dropped back to baseline (<0.05%). good to hold while gateway patch lands. can we add a telemetry flag to count attempted v2 hits from pinned clients? :eyes:

priya.k: i'll update release notes with an "important" callout and send a short opt-in guide to mobile teams. also adding a rollback checklist into the runbook and pinging oncall. CC @lynn for awareness.

jason: short rollback playbook (TL;DR):
1) confirm pin applied (deploy-bot).
2) revert canary traffic -> v1 (route-level traffic override).
3) if gateway patch + client fix not ready in 1h, rollback deploy to previous image.
4) send customer comms if any external clients impacted.

jason: pin rule snippet for ops:
```
match:
  user_agent: /mobile-sdk\/1\.3\.2/
actions:
  route: pin
  version: v1
  ttl: 3600
```

deploy-bot: logged action and audit: https://deploys.redwood/v2/2267899999/audit/rb-2267899999-1.

marcos: :thumbsup: thanks team. followups: priya update notes + comms, samir gateway patch, jason monitor dashboards. i'll reassess at T+55m and either unpin or escalate to full rollback.
